notes: V11 (2026-10-29). Printed: 'At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library.' The intervening-if is an existence test over your creatures (CR 603.4), so with a 5/5 on board the top card (LibB: the opening draw took LibC, and library_top keeps the pack's cards above the runner's filler) is exiled. Before the fix the condition was judged on the enchantment itself and never held.
